recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not restore the older extensible-plus-maxValueSet representation; the current supplemented required binding is the later approved technical correction for the same issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-20617 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested correcting CapabilityStatement.format because it was required-bound to MimeType while allowing xml, json, and ttl, which were not in that value set. The accepted resolution was to use a CapabilityStatement format value set for the simple FHIR format codes and FHIR media types, with a MIME-type maximum binding, while not preventing other MIME types.
initial_application: Git commit b4cf3227e2307b020adaf94603f563b6a8fe777b explicitly applied FHIR-20617 by adding source/capabilitystatement/valueset-capability-format-type.xml and changing CapabilityStatement.format to an extensible capability-format-type binding with a maxValueSet of mimetypes. Commit ba6dd4995575f6af4f7f38c23835ffdbb250256d later converted that representation to a required mimetypes binding plus an additional starter binding to capability-format-type.
additional_context: FHIR-48679 later cited FHIR-20617 and resolved the remaining invalid MIME-type problem by creating supplemented-mimetypes, adding simple-format-codes, and binding CapabilityStatement.format to the supplemented set while keeping the starter binding scoped. FHIR-55152 later confirmed no unknown/other escape valve is needed because all MIME types are included. FHIR-17356 corrected the Turtle media type in the starter set to application/fhir+turtle.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current build-scope source registers CapabilityStatement, simple-format-codes, mimetypes, and supplemented-mimetypes; CapabilityStatement.format is required-bound to ValueSet/supplemented-mimetypes and still has the additional starter binding to ValueSet/capability-format-type. This preserves the FHIR-20617 intent while incorporating later approved corrections.

related_jiras.note: Applied/Persuasive R6 correction that superseded the exact binding representation by adding supplemented-mimetypes and keeping short-form codes scoped to CapabilityStatement.format.
Resolved - No Change request for an escape valve; confirms the current required binding is acceptable because it includes all MIME types.
Corrected the Turtle FHIR media type in the CapabilityStatement starter value set to application/fhir+turtle.
